playback: walk and run stride with the legs: play them at rate = moveSpeed / clips[name].speed_mps so the planted foot does not skate

frame.origin: the cell pivot on the ground under the figure

authoring: Generated by CharacterIso10.gameplay() from the same pose library the clips are exported from. Do not hand-edit — re-generate.
extractor_contract: per clip: pins per frame, in figure-frame metres, unrocked. An absent section means the clip does not use it (not an error). ikShort lists any limb that could not make its target, in metres.

sockets.tool_R: right palm. Rod, spade, knife, gaff: +y runs along the tool (RodIso's rod-local frame), pitched then turned as the clip's tool track says
sockets.tool_R_1: rod bend, chord 1 — 0.40 of the tier length
sockets.tool_R_2: rod bend, chord 2 — 0.70 of the tier length
sockets.tool_L: left palm, same attitude as tool_R while a tool is held (the dig shaft runs left palm to right palm)
sockets.carry_L: left pail handle / oar loom / wheel rim — left palm, swung about local x by the pendulum
sockets.carry_R: right pail handle / oar loom / wheel rim
sockets.carry_mid: tray, pot or wheel centre — midpoint of the palms, chest-parented, swung about local x
sockets.back: slung rod (back mount) — fixed on the chest

blink.name: blink
blink.then: the eyes state of the clip frame that is showing
blink.firstBlink: uniform in [0, a first interval drawn from interval_ms]

look.sense: yaw > 0 turns the face toward the figure's +x (its right); pitch > 0 tips it down (the rig's pitch: the top toward +y)
look.compose: neck.local = clip.neck.local * E(split.neck * yaw, split.neck * pitch); head.local = rock.head * clip.head.local * E(split.head * yaw, split.head * pitch); E(y, p) = Rz(-y) * Rx(-p), angles in degrees, both clamped to the limits first
look.aim: on the frame as the clip poses it (unrocked, no turn): d = the target minus the head point (head bone * headMid), f = the head bone's +y, both in the chest frame; need.yaw = atan2(d.x, d.y) - atan2(f.x, f.y) (wrapped to -180..180), need.pitch = -atan2(d.z, |d.xy|) + atan2(f.z, |f.xy|); turn = clamp(headShare * need) per axis

eyes.rule: eyes.right when need.yaw - turn.yaw > beyond_deg, eyes.left when < -beyond_deg, else eyes.open; only in place of eyes.open (half, shut and wide stay as the clip has them); vertical gaze is the head pitch
